text: Presentation from the Chair, Film, Television, and Digital Media Advisory Committee, and the Film Sector Development Officer, Film and Entertainment Industries, Economic Development and Culture, on the Strategic Action Plan and Board and staff accomplishments.

The Film, Television and Digital Media Advisory Board recommends that: 1. The Economic and Community Development Committee request the General Manager, Economic Development and Culture, in collaboration with the Board, to conduct a scan on workforce requirements, including recruitment from diverse communities and diversification of the workforce in the Film industry.
